Hi everyone!
Any insights or any similar experiences will help:)

My brother got accepted to Ben Gurion University for a masters program-full scholarship,health insurance & flights (they literally pay for everything).

He will be applying for a student visa at Israel embassy in Kenya & ofcourse the school will also send supporting documents.

We’re just a bit concerned if there might be an issue upon arrival in Israel with immigration & anything we should do coz if I understand correctly you might have the visa & all that but still have issues with immigration control given we’re related & I’m in the process.

P.s:I’m from Kenya & in my 2nd A5 visa married.

Thank you!
